notes.title: Bug fix
notes.notes: Fixed the bug that the cat in the main interface would suddenly disappear, oops!

notes.title: Coins update!
notes.notes: Hello everyone! While developing Workshop, I added Cat Gold, and I thought it was interesting enough to update up!

notes.title: Future update plans!
notes.notes:
Future update plans:
1. We just have too few levels (I'm sorry) and I think I need to add Workshop support to the game so that players can build and upload their own levels.

2. I should be adding volume controls shortly, but it should be after the Workshop update!

Thanks again for your patience and support!

notes.title: New feature update!
notes.notes: We recently received a lot of feedback from players: they want to be able to control the camera angle, so we added this feature! Enjoy!
